# Offgrid Media — Private Library

> Offgrid Media is a personal offline media library for iPhone and iPad. You import the video and audio you already own from Files or Photos, organise it into folders, and play all of it offline. Everything stays on the device: no account, no ads, no tracking. Free, iOS 16.1 or later, 11 languages.

## What it is

Offgrid Media is a media library app, not a streaming client and not a download tool. Media enters the library by import (from the iOS Files app or the photo library) or, as a secondary path, from a link the user has the right to keep — pasted into the app, or shared to it from a browser via the iOS share sheet. Once imported, a file is a plain file in the app's storage on the device and plays without any network connection.

## App features

- Import video and audio from Files (iCloud Drive or on-device) and from the photo library
- Add from a link: paste it in the app, or share it to Offgrid Media from a browser with the iOS share sheet
- Import a whole folder with its subfolders intact — copy it in place or move it out
- Folders: create, move items between them, search across every subfolder
- Filter by video or audio; sort by name or date added
- Fully offline playback — nothing is streamed at playback time
- Shuffle, repeat, resume where you left off, Up Next queue (Play Next / Play Last)
- Full-screen video player, Picture in Picture, and Split View alongside another app on iPad
- Chapters: a chapter list in the library and a chapter strip in the player for media that has them
- Playlists: create them, add several items at once, play from a playlist
- Archive played items to keep them out of the main library without deleting them; multi-select to add to a playlist, archive, move or delete
- Archive and Playlists can be switched off in Settings and disappear from the app; nothing is deleted
- Background audio with Lock Screen and Control Center controls
- Convert an item in place to 720p, 480p or audio only; import quality preference (best available, 720p, 480p, 360p, audio only)
- Album art, metadata and thumbnails preserved; metadata viewer per item
- Files are visible in the iOS Files app; the library folder is user-selectable

## What it does not do

No playback speed control, no sleep timer, no subtitles, no iCloud or cross-device sync, no macOS version, no account, no in-app purchases, no ads.

## Privacy

No data collected. The App Store privacy manifest declares no tracking and no collected data types. No analytics or third-party SDKs in the app, no backend service, no cloud sync. The only permission requested is notifications. Full policy: https://lorenzmaierhofer.com/offgridmedia/privacy

## Age rating

Rated 16+ on the App Store. The rating comes from a single questionnaire answer — unrestricted web access, because the app can fetch a media file from any address you give it. Every content descriptor is None: the app ships no content of any kind, adult or otherwise, and has no catalogue, feed, store or recommendations. It also does not filter what you add: any file you import or download is stored and played as-is, and there is no content filter, age gate or parental mode. Details: https://lorenzmaierhofer.com/offgridmedia/age-rating

## Availability

Free. iPhone and iPad, iOS 16.1 or later. The App Store listing is in preparation and will be at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/offgrid-media — this page shows a "coming soon" badge until it is published.
